collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - ISLAND TRADERS (TRD-01..13, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
A trader's canoe comes ashore with something to offer and something to ask for. Trade, haggle (it may go better or worse), or send the trader on with thanks.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A sailmaker with a torn sail offers cutting tools for a bolt of cloth.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A tall sailmaker named Aru limps ashore with a torn sail over one shoulder. A storm ripped it on the crossing, and he needs good cloth to patch it before he can sail on. In return he offers blades he has sharpened from shell and stone. (name1) looks at the village's cloth and has to decide.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) brings a bolt of cloth, and they spend the afternoon stitching it into the sail together. Aru sets two fine cutting tools in (his/her) hands before he goes.

o3.name: Outcome C
o3.text: (name1) explains that the village needs every bolt of its cloth. Aru understands, patches the sail with leaves and twine as best he can, and sets off slowly.

o2.name: Haggle, the better deal
o2.text: (name1) offers to help stitch the sail, too. Aru, grateful for the extra hands, leaves three cutting tools instead of two.

o2b.name: Haggle, the worse deal
o2b.text: (name1) haggles, and Aru, who is in a hurry, gives only one tool for the cloth and stitches the sail alone, muttering.

nothing.name: Nothing to trade
nothing.text: Aru sees the village has no cloth to spare, patches the sail with leaves and twine, and sets off slowly.
